name: MonarchCopyButton
title: CopyButton
summary: A button that copies a string to the pasteboard, shows a short "Copied" state, plays the success haptic and announces the result.
whenToUse: Beside a value the person will paste elsewhere: an API key, a link, a reference number.
whenNotToUse: To send content to another app, use ShareLink. To let people copy text they can also select, text selection (textSelection(.enabled)) may be enough.
api: MonarchCopyButton.init(_ title: String? = nil, value: String, target: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = .secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, isIconOnly: Bool = false, isSensitive: Bool = false, copiedTitle: String? = nil, copiedAnnouncement: String? = nil, resetAfter: Duration = .seconds(2), onCopy: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in title "Copy". Already localised.

options.name: target
options.description: What is copied, added to the spoken name: "Copy webhook URL".

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the copy symbol shown before a copy.

options.name: isIconOnly
options.description: Shows only the icon. The title stays the spoken name.

options.name: isSensitive
options.description: For secrets and recovery codes: the text stays on this device (no Universal Clipboard) and leaves the pasteboard after two minutes.

options.name: copiedAnnouncement
options.description: Replaces the built-in announcement "Copied to clipboard".

options.name: resetAfter
options.description: How long the copied state lasts. Zero keeps it.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Runs with the copied text after each copy.

states.name: idle
states.description: The copy symbol and the title.

states.name: copied
states.description: A checkmark and the copied title, for resetAfter. A second copy restarts the time.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The button's disabled colours, with disabled(_:).

appearance: The Monarch button in the chosen variant, in every theme. The copied state changes the symbol and the title, not the colour.
platformNotes: The web component has an error state because a browser can refuse a clipboard write; writing to UIPasteboard does not fail, so there is no error state, error label or error callback. The web value can be a function or a promise; here it is a string, read when the button is pressed. The web default variant for an icon-only button is ghost; here the default is always secondary. iOS adds the success haptic. On iOS 16 and later the system shows its own paste notice in the app that pastes, not here.
accessibility: It is a standard Button with the Monarch button style, so the trait, the disabled state and the 44-point touch target are the button's.
The spoken name is the visible title followed by target, so several copy buttons on a screen have different names.
With isIconOnly the title is still the spoken name.
After a copy VoiceOver announces "Copied to clipboard" (or copiedAnnouncement), and the name changes to the copied title until the state ends.
The copied state is a checkmark and a changed title, not a colour.
A success haptic is played with sensoryFeedback, which follows the system haptics setting.
edgeCases: Both titles are laid out in the same cell, so the button keeps the width of the longer one.
resetAfter of zero keeps the copied state until the view is recreated.
A custom systemImage replaces only the idle symbol; the copied symbol is always a checkmark.
The value is written to the general pasteboard as plain text and replaces what was there.

examples.title: Labels and icon-only
examples.code:
HStack {
    MonarchCopyButton(value: "https://example.com/hooks/inbound", target: "webhook URL")
    MonarchCopyButton(
        "Copy link",
        value: "https://example.com/s/q3-plan",
        variant: .primary,
        copiedTitle: "Link copied"
    )
    MonarchCopyButton(
        "Copy workspace ID",
        value: "ws_01HZX4",
        variant: .ghost,
        size: .sm,
        isIconOnly: true
    )
}
